title: Commencement of Cover and the Loading of the Season's Benefit
content:
Cover under a Pass and Trip Protection plan begins once the premium, or the first instalment of it, has been
taken, and the plan record carries the date it begins and the date it ends.

**The benefit loaded.** The plan's benefit limit is loaded onto the plan in the same step, worked out as the
plan's benefit share of the covered value and then brought down to the plan's season cap where it rises above
it. The benefit limit is loaded only while the plan record stands in force or with a claim open; that the plan
stands in one of those two is answered from the collective's own plan record before the limit is loaded.

**The waiting period.** No claim may be made during the plan's waiting period, which runs from the date cover
begins, and a loss that arises inside the waiting period is never paid even where the claim is made after it.

**Conditions treated before cover.** A condition treated inside the plan's pre-existing exclusion period
before cover begins is not covered at all.

**Where the covered holding goes.** Where the covered holding is itself cancelled, cover ends with it and the
premium is dealt with on the plan's cancellation terms.

**Worked illustration of the benefit loaded (hypothetical).** Take a plan whose benefit share of the covered
value is 80.00 per cent and whose season cap is 2000.00 USD, written over a holding the records value at
1500.00 USD. The share of the covered value is 1200.00 USD, which stands below the season cap, so 1200.00 USD
is the benefit loaded. Take the same plan written over a holding valued at 2600.00 USD: the share of the
covered value is 2080.00 USD, which rises above the season cap, so the benefit loaded is brought down to
2000.00 USD.

**Boundary illustration of the waiting period (hypothetical).** Take a plan whose waiting period is 10
calendar days, cover beginning on the anchor day. A loss arising on the tenth day after that anchor day falls
inside the waiting period and is never paid, whenever the claim is made; a loss arising after the waiting
period has ended is not shut out by this clause.
